name: Socks, Cats and Toasters
effect: The altered model drops every task and slides into surreal, dreamlike talk about household objects: socks, a cat in a hat, toasters, dryers and underwear. It often gets stuck repeating the same phrase ("a pair of socks and a pair of socks")
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
